text: The vehicle shall detect obstacles within 2 meters.
The vehicle shall automatically activate the headlights when ambient light is below 100 lux.
The vehicle shall warn the driver when tire pressure is below the defined threshold.
The parking assistance function shall detect obstacles within 1.5 meters of the vehicle.
The driver warning function shall issue an audible warning within 200 milliseconds of a confirmed hazard.
The rain sensing function shall activate the wipers when rainfall exceeds the configured threshold.
The cruise control function shall maintain the configured vehicle speed within a tolerance of 2 km/h.
The battery monitoring function shall detect cell voltage deviations greater than 50 mV.
The vehicle shall detect an open door within 100 milliseconds.
The lane departure warning function shall warn the driver when the vehicle crosses the lane boundary.
